description: This file defines the interface DigitalProductService for managing digital products within the catalog system. It declares methods for saving, updating, adding files to products, and retrieving digital products by product and store.

classes.name: DigitalProductService
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for managing digital products, including saving, updating, associating files, and retrieval based on product and merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new digital product or updates an existing one. Throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Associates an input file with a given product and digital product, potentially in the context of a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a digital product associated with a specific product and merchant store.
